remarks: ALL UTILITIES ARE INCLUDED IN RENT for this beautifully renovated, second-floor apartment offering the perfect blend of modern comfort and classic charm and nestled in the highly desirable Greens Farms area of Westport. With its own private entrance, this one-bedroom, one-bathroom unit provides a peaceful and private retreat while being just steps away from all the conveniences of town.  Key features include:   *Newly refinished oak flooring throughout the apartment creates a warm and inviting atmosphere.  * Brand New Kitchenette equipped with brand-new, high-quality appliances, brand new cabinets and countertops perfect for cooking and entertaining.  * Sleek and stylish bathroom with contemporary fixtures and finishes.  * Private Deck: where you can relax and enjoy views of the serene, bucolic backyard.  * Prime location within walking distance to top-rated schools, retail shops, restaurants, and the train station, as well as close proximity to the beach and major highways, this apartment offers the ultimate in convenience and accessibility.  This is a rare opportunity to live in a completely updated, move-in-ready space in one of Westport's most sought-after neighborhoods. Don't miss out-schedule a showing today!
